name: Colmobil
description: One of Israel's largest vehicle importers, owned by the Harel family; imports Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Genesis, Mitsubishi, smart, ORA and Chery-group brands. Its ORA EV launch won the Grand Effie (2025).

relations.note: agency (per trade press / agency client list)

notes: Adler Chomski credited for the ORA launch (Grand Effie + Gold, Effie Israel 2024 awarded Mar 2025). Hebrew Wikipedia dates group origins to 1906 (merged 1962).
